The '''Grand Stairway''' was a curved staircase that passed through at least three stories of a tower that rose from the [[Concessions concourses/Legends|concessions concourses]] in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Color|Gray]] in color, the staircase ended on the top floor of the tower beside rooms for private deal making. A popular place to spot famous [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]], the Grand Stairway was used by a number of individuals during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace<ref name="Inside" /> held in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Stairway was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].
